question: Why did the Habs and Lightning Game 6 go to overtime with a 0-0 score through regulation?
transcript_excerpt: Game 6 between the Habs and Lightning was 0-0 through all of regulation before Tampa scored in overtime to win it. The speaker noted this should have been Game 7 because it was one of the best games he had seen in a long time, and Tampa carried momentum back home on this win.

question: What was the season head-to-head matchup record between Colorado Avalanche and Minnesota Wild in 2024?
transcript_excerpt: The season series between Colorado and Minnesota was evenly split 2-2. Minnesota won in Colorado, Colorado won in Minnesota, Minnesota won in Colorado again, and Colorado won in Minnesota in a shootout. There were two shootouts total—the first game in November was a shootout and the last game was a shootout.

question: Did Stanley Cup Round 2 start before Round 1 was completed in this playoff year?
transcript_excerpt: Yes, for the first time the speakers can remember, Round 2 started before all Round 1 series were finished. The speakers speculated this was likely due to television contracts with TNT or TBS and basketball playoffs happening simultaneously, driving the need for more television slots and revenue rather than being an NHL rule.

question: What was unique about the Phoenix Coyotes' relocation to Utah as an expansion team?
transcript_excerpt: The Utah Hockey Club (formerly Phoenix Coyotes) was not actually an expansion team—the team was moved and relocated rather than newly created. The Phoenix Coyotes had previously played as the Winnipeg Jets and had won playoff series before, so this was a relocated franchise, not an expansion franchise.

question: What architectural feature makes Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle unique for hockey?
transcript_excerpt: Climate Pledge Arena has a strong commitment to carbon zero or net zero and features a living wall covered entirely in plants—a huge green wall that is super cool. The arena is very modern with only two floors instead of the usual three, and has no bad seats, with angular curved jumbotrons on all sides for viewing action.
